tools.name: book_a_call
tools.description: Open Egmer Marketing's booking page so the visitor can schedule a free discovery call. This navigates the current tab to the booking page; the visitor picks the time themselves. Use only when the visitor has said they want to book or talk to someone.

topic.description: Optional. What the visitor wants to talk about, so the agent can tell them what to expect on the call.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether Egmer Marketing serves a given city or area. Egmer is based in the Denver metro and works with clients nationwide, so this reports both the local relationship and the nationwide answer.

city.description: The city or area the visitor is asking about, for example 'Littleton' or 'Kansas City'.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get Egmer Marketing's contact details: phone, email, booking page, service area, and the free community. Use when a visitor asks how to reach Egmer or wants to get in touch.

tools.name: get_free_tools
tools.description: List the free, no-signup tools and resources Egmer Marketing offers: an instant website audit, a free homepage redesign snapshot, a lead leak calculator, the Visibility Score, and a resource library. Use this when a visitor is interested but not ready to talk to anyone, or asks whether there is something free they can try first. Prefer this over book_a_call for anyone still deciding.

tools.name: get_industry_page
tools.description: Get the page Egmer Marketing wrote for a specific type of practice or business, when one exists. Egmer specializes in healthcare practices, so dentists, chiropractors, physical therapists, occupational therapists, optometrists, and general medical practices each have a dedicated page. Use this as soon as a visitor says what kind of business they run.

business_type.description: The visitor's line of work in their own words, for example 'dentist', 'chiropractic clinic', or 'I run a physical therapy practice'.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Get the full detail for one Egmer Marketing service: what it includes, who it is for, the delivery process, and the questions buyers most often ask about it. Requires a service slug from list_services.

slug.description: The service slug, for example 'website-design', 'local-seo', or 'google-business-profile'.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List every marketing service Egmer Marketing offers, with a one-line description of each and the page slug for details. Use this first when a visitor asks what Egmer does or whether Egmer handles a particular kind of work.

tools.name: search_faqs
tools.description: Search Egmer Marketing's published answers to common small business marketing questions (websites, SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, ads, funnels, conversion). Use this to answer a visitor's question in Egmer's own words rather than guessing.

query.description: The visitor's question or a few keywords from it, for example 'how long does SEO take' or 'google maps ranking'.
